chapter: Tulsa bands, Trent, Holder and Kirk
title: Dating his early band, around 1927
summary: Love works out the date from Fields' age; Fields praises Eddie Nicholson's drumming.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Do you know the approximate date and how you were at that time?
When I came out of school in twenty four, I had just had turned twenty one.
I would say about twenty two, twenty three; something like that.
That would have been around nineteen--
You were twenty three and you were born in 1904?
So it would have been around 1927.

Maybe it was; it might have been a little earlier. So anyway, I put him in there and it made a lot of difference as far as the sound when Eddie was playing, because Eddie was a very nice drummer, a very good drummer.
He's a lovable person; I know him very well. The original hip cat.
